outcome: Changes in hiatal area on Valsalva
cohort: 94 women who had a second birth
finding: A second pregnancy and delivery do not seem to have a major effect on bladder support and/or levator function.
mod_finding: While delivery mode of the second birth had little effect on observed changes, there was a trend towards increased bladder-neck descent in women after vaginal delivery and a case of major levator trauma was documented after VBAC.
